verdict.rationale: Evidence covers durable execution, state management, introspection API, and self-hosting, but nothing addresses exporting stored workflow/state data in an open, portable format or a documented way for a user to fully extract and leave with their data. The BSL licensing concern (restate-comm-5) even suggests some restriction on freely building on top of the platform, but this doesn't equate to a data-export capability claim being disputed—it's simply absent.
